exposure: treatment modalities (partial exchange therapy, fluid therapy, observation therapy)
outcome: neonatal hematocrit levels (at 1 hour, 12 hours, 24 hours)
cohort: The study included 50 infants hospitalized in a NICU with a diagnosis of neonatal polycythemia.
finding: Infants receiving fluid therapy showed lower 1-hour hematocrit values upon hospitalization compared to those who did not receive fluid therapy.
